concerns.text: FR‑007 requires the final report to include **both mean and median** time‑to‑success and iteration counts, but T010’s description only mentions median statistics; the mean values are not generated nor verified.
SC‑001 specifies measuring the **mean** difference in time‑to‑success using the Wilcoxon test, yet T009’s description does not state that mean values are computed or reported.

The spec mandates that a trial be considered successful **only if both** the exact vector match **and** the semantic similarity (≥ 0.95) pass. T005 implements the two utilities but the plan’s “Success Validation” step (and T005) allow an **either/or** condition, violating FR‑004, FR‑005, and SC‑003.
SC‑005 requires a measurable verification that the entire pipeline completes within ≤ 6 h on the free‑tier runner, but no task explicitly measures or asserts this runtime limit.

All tasks use tags like `[US1]`, `[US2]` etc., but the specification never defines user‑story IDs of that form (it uses “User Story 1”, “User Story 2”, …). These tags are therefore stale and break traceability.
